title: DAY 36/90
WEEK 6 TEST
scenes.sub: Pitot tubes to steam tables: one test tonight
scenes.voice: Day thirty six of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, seventy days to go! Week six is done. Tonight's weekly test checks fluids, reasoning and thermo together.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: No new chapter today. It is week six revision: flow measurement, viscous and turbulent flow, analytical reasoning, and thermodynamics basics, in one test.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Revise momentum equations and flow meters, laminar flow and boundary layers, pipe losses, reasoning, then pure substances. Redo every question you missed this week.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Laminar pipe flow: kinetic energy factor alpha is two, momentum factor beta is four by three. Turbulent flow: both are nearly one.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The practice PDF is on Telegram now. Weekly test, seven to nine P. M. Take it through our Telegram channel link, or visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 35 Toppers
scenes.voice: Basics and pure substances toppers! Shivam Sahu takes rank one with twenty five point six seven. Sweta Rani Sahoo is rank two, and Pranshu Kumar Yadav rank three. Well done!
